collection.title: Nissan NV250 2019 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Nissan NV250 2019 Onwards model requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 21" the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Bayonet arm attachment.
